doc.title: Bob Wilber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998

title: Jazz fans and categories
summary: Audiences want to categorize players, a problem throughout his career.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: People kind of needed to have a compartment to put you in, in order to know how to listen to it.
Yes. But that’s been a problem all my life because jazz fans do like to categorize. They feel by being able to put you into a category, somehow it shows that they’re knowledgeable about jazz.
